messages:
nina: New hire hit a weird one: README says `pip install redwood` but that pulled an unrelated PyPI package. Their import was pointing to the wrong project.

nina: Quick repro:
```
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install redwood
python -c \"import redwood; print(redwood.__file__, getattr(redwood, '__version__', 'no-version'))\"
```

oliver: Right, our distribution name is `redwood-inference` but our top-level package is `redwood`. If users type the short name pip resolves the other project. Docs should explicitly use the distro name.

mira: Also discovered typing support is missing: our built wheel lacks `py.typed` so mypy and IDEs don't pick up types. Additionally AsyncClient shows up only if you install extras; README examples do `from redwood import AsyncClient` without explaining `[...]`.

oliver: Minimal fixes: 1) change README to `pip install "redwood-inference[async]"` for async examples and `pip install redwood-inference` elsewhere; 2) include `py.typed` in the package and set package_data to include it; 3) add a CI assert that the wheel contains `redwood/py.typed`.

mira: For the import surface, either export AsyncClient at package top-level when extras are present or update examples to `from redwood.async_client import AsyncClient`. Top-level re-export is friendlier.

pkg-bot: Action created: PKG-512 "py.typed + extras + docs" assigned to oliver.

oliver: I'll push a hotfix branch with pyproject changes: add `include = ["redwood/py.typed"]` and `[project.optional-dependencies]
async = ["httpx[http2]>=0.24"]`. Then cut 1.1.3 with the check in CI.

mira: Long-term we should decide: (A) rename top-level package to avoid collisions (breaking), or (B) publish a tiny shim `redwood` that depends on `redwood-inference` and re-exports. Shim buys time but means we own that package name. Create a roadmap ticket.

oliver: Agreed. For now hotfix + doc update + CI check. I'll also grep the repo for any `pip install redwood` occurrences and send a PR.

nina: Thanks — I'll update onboarding notes and leave a comment on the Sentry issues that were caused by this.

pkg-bot: CI: packaging-check started for refs/heads/fix/pytyped (run #789).

pkg-bot: CI: packaging-check passed; wheel contains redwood/py.typed. Release 1.1.3-pre published.
